headline: Social Media Marketing Manager | F&B Growth & Content Strategy
summary: Creative and analytical Social Media Marketing Manager with 3+ years of experience driving brand growth, community engagement, and paid advertising success. Expert in translating consumer behavior insights and competitor benchmarking into high-impact content strategies for Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. Proficient in Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads, with a strong focus on short-form video production, social listening, and data-backed reporting to maximize ROI and brand visibility.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Developed and executed end-to-end social media strategies across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, resulting in significant audience growth and engagement increases.
Managed paid advertising campaigns via Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads, optimizing ROAS and conversion rates through A/B testing and precise audience targeting.
Produced high-quality short-form video content (Reels/TikToks) and copy, leveraging CapCut and Canva to align with brand identity and viral trends.
Conducted regular competitor benchmarking and social listening to identify market shifts, integrating actionable insights into content calendars and campaign adjustments.
Monitored daily channel performance, generating detailed analytics reports to drive data-backed recommendations for improved engagement and ROI.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Oversaw day-to-day operations of social media channels, ensuring consistent posting and active community engagement through comments and direct messages.
Designed content strategies based on consumer behavior research, tailoring messaging to resonate with target audiences in MENA and EU markets.
Collaborated with creative teams to produce visual assets and video content, maintaining brand consistency across all digital touchpoints.
Tracked key performance indicators (KPIs) such as engagement rate, reach, and click-through rate, providing weekly reports to stakeholders.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Social Media Marketing Manager position at ScaleUp. With over three years of experience driving growth for digital brands, I specialize in creating engaging short-form video content and optimizing paid campaigns on Meta and TikTok. My background in social listening and competitor analysis allows me to stay ahead of trends, ensuring your F&B brand remains relevant and visible. I am eager to bring my analytical approach and creative flair to your team, helping to scale your social presence and achieve measurable business results.

screening.q: Do you have experience in the Food & Beverage (F&B) industry?
screening.a: Yes, I have managed social media strategies and content for brands with consumer-facing products, applying F&B-specific engagement tactics and trend analysis.

screening.q: Are you proficient in Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads?
screening.a: Yes, I have direct experience setting up, targeting, and optimizing campaigns on both platforms to achieve growth and conversion KPIs.

screening.q: Can you produce short-form video content?
screening.a: Yes, I am proficient in using CapCut and Canva to conceptualize, edit, and schedule high-quality Reels and TikToks.
